data_source: ECMWF IFS ENS 50 members via WeatherBench 2 (64x32, 5.625 deg), Z500
selection_note: Hidden-bust stress case: 21 hidden-bust region-days at Day 3-7 (selected by verification only; not representative)

alert_threshold.definition: FULL model probability giving 10% false-alarm rate on VALIDATION (product threshold)

priority_formula.formula: score = p_bust * 0.5**((lead_day-1)/H) * evidence_weight + B * max(0, p_bust - p_B2)
priority_formula.note: Product triage rule; weights are design choices, not fitted or validated constants.

attribution_note: TreeSHAP contributions (log-odds, before isotonic calibration). They describe what the model used; they are associations, not physical causes.
